mapper.sql: c.id, c.ctrl_id, c.status, c.result, c.started_at, c.ended_at, c.version, NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.attributes, '$.guestChannelUuid')), 'null') AS guest_channel_uuid, NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.attributes, '$.agentChannelUuid')), 'null') AS agent_channel_uuid
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fcc_call_session c WHERE c.id > #{after} AND c.started_at < #{cutoff} AND ( c.status NOT IN ('NORMAL_END', 'ERROR_END') OR c.ended_at IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fcc_call_leg l WHERE l.call_id = c.id AND (l.ended_at IS NULL OR l.state != 'DESTROY')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fcc_call_bridge b WHERE b.call_id = c.id AND b.ended_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fcc_flow_instance f WHERE f.call_id = c.id AND (f.status != 'ENDED' OR f.ended_at IS NULL)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fcc_flow_step_execution s WHERE s.call_id = c.id AND s.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED', 'UNKNOWN')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fcc_agent_presence p WHERE p.active_call_id = c.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fcc_call_recording r WHERE r.call_id = c.id AND r.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'RECORDING')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fcc_dial_attempt a WHERE a.call_id = c.id AND a.status = 'RUNNING') ) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM fcc_call_session c WHERE c.id IN ORDER BY c.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT call_id, channel_uuid, ended_at, hangup_cause AS cause FROM fcc_call_leg WHERE call_id IN UNION ALL SELECT call_id, channel_uuid, CASE WHEN COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(normalized_payload, '$.end_epoch') + 0, 0) > 0 THEN TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, JSON_EXTRACT(normalized_payload, '$.end_epoch') + 0, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') ELSE event_time END AS ended_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(normalized_payload, '$.cause')) AS cause FROM fcc_call_event WHERE call_id IN AND event_type = 'Event.Channel' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(normalized_payload, '$.state')) = 'DESTROY' AND channel_uuid IS NOT NULL

SELECT FROM fcc_call_session c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fcc_call_leg l WHERE l.call_id = c.id AND l.channel_uuid = #{channelUuid} AND l.node_id = #{nodeId}) OR (c.ctrl_id = #{ctrlId} AND (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.attributes, '$.guestChannelUuid')) = #{channelUuid} OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.attributes, '$.agentChannelUuid')) = #{channelUuid})) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_call_leg SET state = 'DESTROY', ended_at = COALESCE(ended_at, GREATEST(created_time, #{endedAt})), hangup_cause = COALESCE(hangup_cause, #{cause}), version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE call_id = #{callId} AND channel_uuid = #{channelUuid} AND node_id = #{nodeId} AND (state != 'DESTROY' OR ended_at IS NULL OR hangup_cause IS NULL)

UPDATE fcc_call_leg l JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.id = l.call_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT call_id, channel_uuid, MAX(event_time) AS ended_at FROM fcc_call_event WHERE call_id IN AND event_type = 'Event.Channel' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(normalized_payload, '$.state')) = 'DESTROY' GROUP BY call_id, channel_uuid ) e ON e.call_id = l.call_id AND e.channel_uuid = l.channel_uuid SET l.state = 'DESTROY', l.ended_at = COALESCE(l.ended_at, e.ended_at, c.ended_at), l.hangup_cause = COALESCE(l.hangup_cause, CASE WHEN e.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN c.result ELSE 'RECOVERY_UNKNOWN' END), l.version = l.version + 1, l.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE c.id IN AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND (l.ended_at IS NULL OR l.state != 'DESTROY') AND (e.ended_at IS NOT NULL OR #{channelsAbsent} = TRUE)

UPDATE fcc_call_bridge_member m JOIN fcc_call_bridge b ON b.id = m.bridge_id JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.id = b.call_id SET m.left_at = GREATEST(m.joined_at, c.ended_at) WHERE c.id IN AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND m.left_at IS NULL
UPDATE fcc_call_bridge b JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.id = b.call_id SET b.ended_at = GREATEST(b.started_at, c.ended_at) WHERE c.id IN AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND b.ended_at IS NULL

UPDATE fcc_flow_step_execution s JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.id = s.call_id SET s.status = 'INTERRUPTED', s.ended_at = GREATEST(s.started_at, c.ended_at), s.duration_ms = GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, s.started_at, c.ended_at) DIV 1000), s.error_code = COALESCE(s.error_code, 'CALL_ENDED'), s.error_message = COALESCE(s.error_message, '通话已结束，步骤没有可确认的最终完成结果') WHERE c.id IN AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND s.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING', 'ACCEPTED', 'UNKNOWN')

UPDATE fcc_flow_instance f JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.id = f.call_id SET f.status = 'ENDED', f.current_step_key = 'END', f.ended_at = COALESCE(f.ended_at, GREATEST(f.started_at, c.ended_at)), f.version = f.version + 1, f.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE c.id IN AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND (f.status != 'ENDED' OR f.ended_at IS NULL)

UPDATE fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.id = p.active_call_id JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = p.agent_id SET p.active_call_id = NULL, p.work_status = CASE p.login_status WHEN 'LOGIN' THEN 'READY' WHEN 'LOGIN_BUSY' THEN 'BUSY' ELSE 'UNREADY' END, p.last_state_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), p.version = p.version + 1 WHERE c.id IN AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('NORMAL_END', 'ERROR_END') AND

UPDATE fcc_call_recording r JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.id = r.call_id SET r.status = 'UNKNOWN', r.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE c.id IN AND c.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND r.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'RECORDING')
